name: @radardata/sdk
description: SDK oficial do RadarData para Node e TypeScript: consultas, Verify, Motor de Analises e webhooks.
author: RadarData

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('dist/cjs/package.json', JSON.stringify({type:'commonjs'}))"
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run test && npm run build
